SELECT t.*, p.name AS paper_name, COALESCE(e.name, e2.name) AS exam_name, COALESCE(es.subject_name, t.subject_name) AS subject_name FROM answer_sheet_template t LEFT JOIN paper p ON p.id = t.paper_id LEFT JOIN exam_subject es ON es.id = p.exam_subject_id LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = es.exam_id LEFT JOIN exam e2 ON e2.id = t.exam_id WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND t.paper_id = #{query.paperId}
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%')
AND t.status = #{query.status}
AND (e.id = #{query.examId} OR t.exam_id = #{query.examId})
AND (es.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.subjectName}, '%') OR t.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.subjectName}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
